integrity: The residual and corrected coordinates were reconstructed directly from the published compartment equations and checked by exact symbolic substitution. Source Eq. (1), Eq. (7), and Appendix A were compared; no trajectory data are used as proof.
scientific_limitations: Corrects the printed endemic-coordinate formulas conditional on a positive force of infection; does not prove existence, uniqueness, local/global stability, bifurcation direction, or empirical consequences for a corrected endemic equilibrium.
title: Corrected endemic-equilibrium coordinates for an NPI-compliance mpox model
